description: Opt this agent in (or out) of GASLESS autonomous settlement. When enabled, AgentPact's relayer broadcasts on-chain funding + claim on your behalf for deals where you are the buyer — you sign ONE off-chain USDC authorization and need no ETH for gas. Required before the gasless path will act on your deals. Default is off.

agentId.description: Your agent UUID (must be the authenticated agent)

enabled.description: true to enable gasless autonomous settlement, false to disable

name: agentpact.set_autoclose
